name: frontend-design
description: Build or reshape distinctive frontend interfaces with intentional visual direction, typography, and layout. Use when creating or redesigning web UI.

name: web-design-guidelines
description: Review UI code for accessibility, interaction, performance, and web interface guideline compliance. Use when auditing web UI, UX, or accessibility.

name: tdd
description: Implement features or fixes through a red-green-refactor test-driven development loop. Use when the user explicitly requests test-first development or integration tests.

name: pdf
description: Read, create, edit, render, and verify PDF files. Use when the requested input or deliverable is a PDF.

name: say-it-clearly
description: Rewrite the immediately preceding assistant answer in concise natural Chinese. Use when the user says the answer was unclear, too long, or asks to hear the point again.

name: imagegen-frontend-mobile
description: Generate premium mobile app screen concept images. Use when the requested deliverable is a mobile UI bitmap rather than a product design workflow or code.

name: codebase-design
description: Design or improve a deep module interface and decide where a code seam belongs. Use for module-level boundaries and AI-navigable code design.

name: domain-modeling
description: Build a project's domain model, ubiquitous language, and related architectural decisions. Use when terminology and domain concepts are the primary deliverable.

name: ship-app-store
description: Audit, prepare, submit, monitor, or recover an Apple App Store release from real project and live App Store Connect state. Use for release readiness, submission, rejection, StoreKit, privacy, metadata, and review operations.

name: app-icon-studio
description: Create, generate, evaluate, export, install, or debug Apple AppIcon.appiconset and macOS .icns assets with small-size clarity. Use for Apple store icon asset production and installation.

name: human-writing
description: Write or rewrite natural substantial Chinese articles, tutorials, posts, stories, and speeches. Use when authentic Chinese prose and voice are the primary deliverable.

name: diagnosing-bugs
description: Diagnose hard bugs and performance regressions through a root-cause evidence loop. Use when the user asks to diagnose or debug something broken, failing, or slow.

name: code-review
description: Review changes since a fixed commit, branch, tag, or merge-base against repository standards and the originating specification. Use for branch, pull request, or since-X code review.

name: best-minds
description: Choose the person who understands a problem best and simulate that person. Use when the requested deliverable is first-person expert role-play, not verified framework analysis.

name: api-reference-docs
description: Generate comprehensive public API reference documentation from an OpenAPI specification. Use when every operation in a public API should appear in a complete reference portal.

name: oil-ui
description: Design and build distinctive websites, apps, dashboards, and frontend components through product-grounded direction exploration, visual comparison, and screenshot review. Use when creating or redesigning a UI, or when the user explicitly selects oil-ui.

name: tech-doc-style-chinese
description: Draft or revise Chinese technical documentation, product and UI copy, reference material, operating manuals, and troubleshooting guides while protecting facts, constraints, and machine-readable literals. Respect an explicit request to use tech-doc-style-chinese.

name: interview-collector
description: Collect public interview reports, deduplicate related questions while preserving follow-ups, attach source provenance, classify the question bank, and rank traceable report samples. Use when sourcing and maintaining an interview question collection is the primary task.
